verses.1: The Book of the Generation of Jesus Christ, Son of David, Son of Abraham.
verses.2: Abram gave birth to Isac. Isac, in turn, gave birth to Jacob. Jacob, then, gave birth to Jude and his brothers.
verses.3: Eudas, on the other hand, gave birth to Phares and Zara from Thamar. Phares, in turn, gave birth to Esrom. Esrom, after that, gave birth to Aram.
verses.4: Arām, in turn, gave birth to Aminadab. Aminadab, in turn, gave birth to Naasson. Naasson, in turn, gave birth to Salmón.
verses.5: Salmon, in turn, gave birth to Boes from Rhaachav. Boes, in turn, gave birth to Iowed from Routh. Iowed, in turn, gave birth to Iessai.
verses.6: And Jezebel gave birth to David, the king. And David gave birth to Solomon from Urish.
verses.7: Solomon gave birth to Roboam. Roboam, in turn, gave birth to Abiiah. Abiiah, then, gave birth to Asaph.
verses.8: Asaph then gave birth to Joshuaafat; Joshuaafat gave birth to Yoharam; Yoharam gave birth to Ozyan.
verses.9: Ozias gave birth to Ioatham. Ioatham, in turn, gave birth to Achaas. Achaas, then, gave birth to Ezekian.
verses.10: Hizkiah gave birth to Manasseh. Manasseh, in turn, gave birth to Amos. Amos, then, gave birth to Josiah.
verses.11: Eosias, however, gave birth to Iechonias and his brothers as tenants in Babylon.
verses.12: After the relocation to Babylon, Echonia gave birth to Salathiel. And Salathiel gave birth to Zorobabel.
verses.13: Zorobabel then gave birth to Abiud; Abiud gave birth to Elyakim; Elyakim gave birth to Azor.
verses.14: Azor, on the other hand, gave birth to Sadok. Sadok, in turn, gave birth to Ahim. Ahim, finally, gave birth to Eliud.
verses.15: And Eliousd gave birth to Eleazar. Eleazar, in turn, gave birth to Mattathias. Mattathias, then, gave birth to Jacob.
verses.16: Jakobus, on the other hand, gave birth to Joseph. From this marriage, Jesus, also known as Christ, was born.
verses.17: In total, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David. Then, from David until the time of Babylon’s conquest, there were also fourteen generations. And from the time of Babylon’s conquest until Christ’s birth, there were again fourteen generations.
verses.18: And the birth of Jesus Christ was as follows: After his mother Mary was baptized by Joseph, they were found in a tomb, filled with the Holy Spirit.
verses.19: But her husband, who was a just man and not wanting to humiliate her, decided to kill her.
verses.20: When he heard these words, an angel of the Lord appeared to him one morning and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife. For she will bear a son, who will be the Savior of the world.”
verses.21: And he will also save his son’s life. He will give him the name “Jesus”. For he will indeed save his people from their sins.
verses.22: All of this happened in order to fulfill the obligation owed by the king, as spoken by the prophet.
verses.23: I saw that the virgin is carrying and nurturing her child in her womb. They give her the name Emmanuel. She is, in fact, the God who is worshipped by us.
verses.24: But Joseph, having awakened from his sleep, did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him. He then took his wife to be his wife.
verses.25: And he did not circumcise her until she gave birth to a son. Then he named the boy Jesus.
